visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with her hair tied in two pigtails, wearing a grey and black horizontal striped long-sleeve shirt and grey sweatpants, walks away from the camera through a doorway in a clean, brightly lit modern home. She pauses briefly to look back at the lens, her face showing a neutral but curious expression before proceeding. (2) The scene cuts to the toddler leaning over a large, white circular plastic cat litter box. She repeatedly slaps the rim with both hands, showing focus and repetitive physical movement. A woman wearing a striped sweater and dark trousers enters the frame from the side, gently grasping the toddler's hands to stop her and leading her away from the object. (3) The child stands centrally in a minimalist room with white walls and wooden flooring, looking directly at the camera. She begins to bounce her knees and sway her torso in a rhythmic, dance-like motion while maintaining a calm gaze. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textures of her cotton clothing. (4) The toddler approaches a grey ergonomic office chair. She reaches up, grips the removable grey seat cushion, and pulls it down onto the floor with a purposeful tug. An adult's hands appear briefly to assist her as she carefully sits down cross-legged on the floor-bound cushion, looking up toward the camera at the end. (5) A pink graphic outro screen appears featuring a cartoon illustration of the child waving, accompanied by centered white text on a solid background.
